items.name: badrex/Ethio-ASR-multilingual-600M
items.summary: Ethio-ASR is a suite of multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models that support five Ethiopian languages: Amharic, Tigrinya, Afaan Oromo, Sidama, and Wolaytta. The ASR model in this repo is based on the wav2vec2‑bert-2.0 pre-trained model by fine-tuning it on the WAXAL Speech Dataset.

items.name: badrex/w2v-bert-2.0-kinyarwanda-asr
items.summary: This model is a fine-tuned version of Wav2Vec2-BERT 2.0 for Kinyarwanda automatic speech recognition (ASR). It was trained on the 1000 hours dataset from the Kinyarwanda ASR hackthon on Kaggle (Track B), dataset covering Health, Government, Finance, Education, and Agriculture domains.

items.name: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-Embedding-350M

items.name: lmsys/fastchat-t5-3b-v1.0
items.summary: Model type: FastChat-T5 is an open-source chatbot trained by fine-tuning Flan-t5-xl (3B parameters) on user-shared conversations collected from ShareGPT. It is based on an encoder-decoder transformer architecture, and can autoregressively generate responses to users' inputs.

items.name: lmsys/vicuna-13b-delta-v1.1
items.summary: NOTE: New version available Please check out a newer version of the weights here.

items.name: lmsys/vicuna-7b-v1.5
items.summary: Vicuna is a chat assistant trained by fine-tuning Llama 2 on user-shared conversations collected from ShareGPT.

items.name: LnL-AI/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0-GPTQ-4bit
items.summary: This is TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 quantized with AutoGPTQ in GPTQ 4-bit format.

items.name: local-inference-lab/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-FLARE
items.summary: Run this prepared Flare runtime on four NVIDIA SM120 GPUs with 96 GB VRAM each. It supports 32 concurrent requests, seven DSpark draft tokens per round, text and images, and a 1,048,576-token per-request context limit. Serving uses Flare's native Rust runtime without Python or runtime compilation.

items.name: local-inference-lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FLARE
items.summary: This repository provides an alpha-quality prepared runtime package for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next( built exclusively for a community preview of Flare. It includes model weights, compiled CUDA kernels, and captured execution graphs.

items.name: local-inference-lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4
items.summary: local-inference-lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 is a mixed-precision model distilled from Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next using quantization-aware distillation (QAD).

items.name: LocalAI-io/LocalVQE
items.summary: Local Voice Quality Enhancement — compact neural models for acoustic echo cancellation (AEC), noise suppression (NS), and dereverberation of 16 kHz speech, running on commodity CPUs in real time. Causal and streaming (256-sample hop, 16 ms latency).

items.name: LocalAI-io/privacy-filter-nemotron-GGUF
items.summary: GGUF conversion of OpenMed/privacy-filter-nemotron, a fine-grained PII token-classification model — a fine-tune of openai/privacy-filter on the nvidia/Nemotron-PII dataset.

items.name: LocalAI-io/TRELLIS.2-4B-GGUF
items.summary: GGUF (f16) conversions of microsoft/TRELLIS.2-4B for the trellis2cpp / ggml runtime — a CUDA-free, PyTorch-free C++ port of the TRELLIS.2 image-to-3D pipeline. Load these directly; no safetensors conversion or Python is needed at inference.

items.name: lodestones/Chroma1-HD
items.summary: Chroma1-HD is an 8.9B parameter text-to-image foundational model based on FLUX.1-schnell. It is fully Apache 2.0 licensed, ensuring that anyone can use, modify, and build upon it.

items.name: lodestones/Kromoss
items.summary: Kromoss is a full fine-tune of MOSS-Image-Base at 1024 px. It uses the same architecture, inference pipeline, text encoder (Qwen3.5-9B) and VAE (FLUX.2 small decoder) as MOSS-Image-SFT, and this repo has the same layout, so it is a drop-in replacement.

items.name: lodestones/MOSS-Image-Base-8-steps-dmd
items.summary: Work-in-progress distillation of OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Image-Base (50 steps, CFG 3) to 8 network evaluations, no CFG. Data-space DMD (arXiv 2610.12102): the generator iterates on its own clean estimate from fixed noise. Trained on compact-JSON scene_graph captions.

items.name: OpenGVLab/pvt_v2_b0
items.summary: This is the Hugging Face PyTorch implementation of the PVTv2 model.

items.name: OpenGVLab/VideoChat-Flash-Qwen2-7B_res448
items.summary: VideoChat-Flash-7B is constructed upon UMT-L (300M) and Qwen2-7B, employing only 16 tokens per frame. By leveraging Yarn to extend the context window to 128k (Qwen2's native context window is 32k), our model supports input sequences of up to approximately 10,000 frames.

items.name: OpenGVLab/VideoMAEv2-Base
items.summary: VideoMAEv2-Base model pre-trained for 800 epochs in a self-supervised way on UnlabeldHybrid-1M dataset. It was introduced in the paper [[CVPR23]VideoMAE V2: Scaling Video Masked Autoencoders with Dual Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.12602) by Wang et al. and first released in GitHub.

items.name: OpenHands/openhands-lm-32b-v0.1
items.summary: Autonomous agents for software development are already contributing to a wide range of software development tasks. But up to this point, strong coding agents have relied on proprietary models, which means that even if you use an open-source agent like OpenHands, you are still reliant on API calls…

items.name: openjev/openjev
items.summary: Typed decisions about text, web pages and screenshots. One forward pass per question with up to 52 options. About 210 ms for an isolated web decision on one H100, with roughly 1,460 prompt tokens and 23 options.

items.name: openjev/openjev-FP8
items.summary: The FP8 file of OpenJev: the same weights stored as FP8 (e4m3, 128×128 weight blocks, dynamic activations), about 29 GB instead of 54 GB. Everything about the model, the API and the results is in the main card; this page only says how this file was checked and how to run it.

items.name: openlm-research/open_llama_13b
items.summary: In this repo, we present a permissively licensed open source reproduction of Meta AI's LLaMA large language model. We are releasing 3B, 7B and 13B models trained on 1T tokens.

items.name: openlm-research/open_llama_3b_v2
items.summary: TL;DR: we are releasing our public preview of OpenLLaMA, a permissively licensed open source reproduction of Meta AI’s LLaMA. We are releasing a series of 3B, 7B and 13B models trained on different data mixtures.

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-14B-Chat
items.summary: 通义千问-14B（Qwen-14B）是阿里云研发的通义千问大模型系列的140亿参数规模的模型。Qwen-14B是基于Transformer的大语言模型, 在超大规模的预训练数据上进行训练得到。预训练数据类型多样，覆盖广泛，包括大量网络文本、专业书籍、代码等。同时，在Qwen-14B的基础上，我们使用对齐机制打造了基于大语言模型的AI助手Qwen-14B-Chat。本仓库为Qwen-14B-Chat的仓库。

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-72B
items.summary: 通义千问-72B（Qwen-72B）是阿里云研发的通义千问大模型系列的720亿参数规模的模型。Qwen-72B是基于Transformer的大语言模型, 在超大规模的预训练数据上进行训练得到。预训练数据类型多样，覆盖广泛，包括大量网络文本、专业书籍、代码等。同时，在Qwen-72B的基础上，我们使用对齐机制打造了基于大语言模型的AI助手Qwen-72B-Chat。本仓库为Qwen-72B的仓库。

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-7B
items.summary: 通义千问-7B（Qwen-7B）是阿里云研发的通义千问大模型系列的70亿参数规模的模型。Qwen-7B是基于Transformer的大语言模型, 在超大规模的预训练数据上进行训练得到。预训练数据类型多样，覆盖广泛，包括大量网络文本、专业书籍、代码等。同时，在Qwen-7B的基础上，我们使用对齐机制打造了基于大语言模型的AI助手Qwen-7B-Chat。相较于最初开源的Qwen-7B模型，我们现已将预训练模型和Chat模型更新到效果更优的版本。本仓库为Qwen-7B预训练模型的仓库。

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-7B-Chat
items.summary: 通义千问-7B（Qwen-7B）是阿里云研发的通义千问大模型系列的70亿参数规模的模型。Qwen-7B是基于Transformer的大语言模型, 在超大规模的预训练数据上进行训练得到。预训练数据类型多样，覆盖广泛，包括大量网络文本、专业书籍、代码等。同时，在Qwen-7B的基础上，我们使用对齐机制打造了基于大语言模型的AI助手Qwen-7B-Chat。相较于最初开源的Qwen-7B模型，我们现已将预训练模型和Chat模型更新到效果更优的版本。本仓库为Qwen-7B-Chat的仓库。

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B
items.summary: Qwen-AgentWorld is the first language world model to cover seven agent interaction domains within a single model. It simulates agentic environments via long chain-of-thought reasoning, predicting the next environment state given an agent's action and interaction history.

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-Image
items.summary: Install the latest version of diffusers

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1
items.summary: We are excited to open-source Qwen-Image-2.1, a unified text-to-image generation and image editing model in the Qwen family. With just 7B parameters in its visual generation component (32 Single-Stream DiT layers), Qwen-Image-2.1 balances generation quality, inference efficiency, and versatility.

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo
items.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an accelerated checkpoint of Qwen-Image-2.1 for text-to-image generation and image editing with 8 denoising steps. It uses the same 7B visual generation architecture and loads directly with QwenImage21Pipeline in Diffusers.

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-Image-2512
items.summary: We conducted over 10,000 rounds of blind model evaluations on AI Arena, and the results show that Qwen-Image-2512 is currently the strongest open-source model—while remaining highly competitive even among closed-source models.

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-Image-Bench
items.summary: A fine-tuned judge model for evaluating text-to-image (T2I) generation quality. Built on top of Qwen3.6-27B, it scores generated images across 5 hierarchical dimensions using structured checklists and outputs JSON-formatted evaluation results.

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511
items.summary: We are excited to introduce Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, an enhanced version over Qwen-Image-Edit-2509, featuring multiple improvements—including notably better consistency. To try out the latest model, please visit Qwen Chat and select the Image Editing feature.

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-Image-Layered
items.summary: After decomposition, edits are applied exclusively to the target layer, physically isolating it from the rest of the content, and thereby fundamentally ensuring consistency across edits.

items.name: Qwen/Qwen-VL-Chat
items.summary: Qwen-VL 是阿里云研发的大规模视觉语言模型（Large Vision Language Model, LVLM）。Qwen-VL 可以以图像、文本、检测框作为输入，并以文本和检测框作为输出。Qwen-VL 系列模型性能强大，具备多语言对话、多图交错对话等能力，并支持中文开放域定位和细粒度图像识别与理解。
